what: Functions from chrome.exe/chrome_elf.dll/chrome.dll import tables that Chromium's own code called during `chrome.exe --headless --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --single-process --dump-dom file:///Z:/.../page.html` under Wine 9.0 (wine64 9.0~repack-4build3) with xvfb-run on the Linux build host. WINEDEBUG=+relay,+pid with RelayFromExclude listing every builtin module the run loads (so only calls made by the native Chromium images are traced). Matched to the import tables by function name. Host-side evidence only; says nothing about Kernel64.
result: no DOM printed; killed by the 150 s timeout (exit 124). The run ended with Wine reporting a stack overflow in the browser process' thread 0024 (cause not investigated; relay adds stack use). Without relay the same command stalls after browser start-up (ELECTRON_TARGET.md section 10.2). A lower bound on the M2 call set.
